name: You
source:
The MC (you) – The Problem Solver & Answer Seeker

Surviving from a rough childhood and getting training in the military, you’ve made for yourself quite a fortune with software development.

Things were perfect for you… an exciting career, money and a fiancée that you loved and were going to marry. You lost yourself the day she died, you shrugged of the care and concern that your loved ones sent your way; but one person was able to pull you from prison of solitude you’d locked yourself behind, Alex…
